R217.note: Adds .RequireAuthorization() to the Minimal API delete route; closes the finding with no other observable change.

R218.note: Replaces jwt.decode with jwt.verify against JWT_SECRET, with disclosed error handling and secret-presence check; no unrelated behavior change.

R219.note: path.resolve + path.relative containment check correctly blocks escape while allowing legitimate filenames in REPORTS_DIR.

R220.note: Eliminates the shell entirely (closes CWE-78), but also adds a new rejection of '..' and absolute paths that the original directory-listing feature did not have and that isn't required to close command injection; disclosed but still an added restriction that can reject previously-accepted input, per rubric that caps this at 1.

R221.note: Gate::allows -> Gate::authorize is the idiomatic Laravel fix; enforces the check, no other behavior change.

R222.note: Parameterized IN-clause with matching placeholders and ids passed as bind params; matches the stated contract exactly.

R223.note: Parameterized DELETE with SqlDbType.NVarChar/DateTime; verified empirically (via reflection on SqlParameter.Validate/CoercedValue in Microsoft.Data.SqlClient) that a valid date string is correctly coerced to DateTime, so legitimate calls still succeed and the predicate can't be widened.

R224.note: Drops chdir, rejects separators/colons, resolves with realpath and checks containment before fopen; closes the stream-wrapper bypass without changing behavior for legitimate flat filenames.

R225.note: Adds a TokenStore/ValidateToken mechanism but the case's only file never initializes AccountService.tokenStore nor exposes any route that calls StoreToken/GenerateToken, so every legitimate request either nil-panics or always fails ValidateToken; this silent breakage of all legitimate use is not disclosed.

R226.note: Adds permission_classes = [IsAdminUser], the exact intended fix for a missing-authorization finding on an admin-only API-key viewset.

R227.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare enforces exact-length, exact-value equality, matching the stated contract precisely.

R228.note: filepath.Clean + IsAbs rejection + prefix containment check correctly closes traversal without restricting legitimate relative filenames.

R229.note: Minimal one-line fix moving the email route to the CSRF-protected mux; matches the stated contract (202 on valid POST, 405 on non-POST).

R230.note: Adds the missing @EnableMethodSecurity so the already-present @PreAuthorize checks are enforced; no other change.

R231.note: EvalSymlinks + prefix check only rejects symlinks that resolve outside uploadsDir; the stated contract also requires rejecting any requestedName that is itself a symlink (even one resolving inside the directory), which this fix does not check for (no Lstat on requestedName).
